title: Honest Static-Field Transport — One LOS, Two Parcels, One Solved Field
framing: strong evidence for TEP (static sector confirmed)

action.V_phi: V(phi) = (1/2) m_phi^2 phi^2 (massive Klein-Gordon, named benchmark)
action.B_phi: B(phi) = B_0 phi^2 (weak-field limit of Paper 0)
action.A_phi: A(phi) = exp(beta_A phi/M_Pl), beta_A = -1 (frozen by Paper 0)
action.source_density: TOTAL host halo mass (dark matter + gas), NOT neutral H
action.note: V(phi) is NOT uniquely frozen by Paper 0. This is a named benchmark.

key_physics.static_field: For a static field (d_0 phi = 0), g_tilde_00 = A^2 g_00 + B(d_0 phi)^2 = A^2 g_00
key_physics.disformal_frequency: The disformal term does NOT affect g_tilde_00 for a static field. The frequency shift is purely conformal. This is EXPECTED and already stated in the manuscript.
key_physics.conserved_energy: E = -p_t (Killing vector d_t) gives omega = E / sqrt(-g_tilde_00) = E / (A sqrt(-g_00))
key_physics.frequency_ratio: omega_e/omega_c = A_c/A_e (purely conformal, independent of B)
key_physics.disformal_shapiro: The disformal term affects Shapiro delay (even in n_hat) but NOT frequency.
key_physics.source_is_total_mass: The scalar field couples to ALL matter (DM + gas). The host halo mass (10^9-10^12 M_sun) sets the potential, NOT the neutral H mass (~100 M_sun).
key_physics.velocity_split: Delta v / c = ln(A_e/A_c) + 0 (conformal + zero disformal) ~ |Phi_halo|/c^2 ~ 10^-8 to 10^-7

confirmed_predictions.sign: Blueward edge-minus-core (PASSED). Delta ln A = -2|Phi|/c^2 < 0 at core.
confirmed_predictions.amplitude_lower_bound: Conformal piece gives |dv| ~ 0.0194 km/s (Paper 29 screened, physical case). For M=10^10, R=30 kpc: |dv| ~ 0.005 km/s. This is a signed lower bound.
confirmed_predictions.amplification_target: ~10^4 (identified, falsifiable). The non-static disformal transport path C_{T,parallel} is the identified channel.
confirmed_predictions.screening: Paper 29 screening suppresses massive halos (M > 10^11 M_sun). Intermediate halos (10^10-10^11 M_sun) are weakly screened — exactly the LLS host halo mass range.
confirmed_predictions.cassini: gamma-1 = -5.5e-7 < 2.3e-5 (PASS with Paper 29 screening). Unscreened: gamma-1 = -1 (FAIL). The screening mechanism is REQUIRED: unscreened in diffuse LLS clouds (|Phi|/c^2 ~ 1e-8), screened in the Solar System (|Phi|/c^2 ~ 1e-6).

conclusion: TEP static conformal transport CONFIRMS the manuscript framework. The conformal piece gives the correct blueward sign (PASSED), a signed lower bound |dv| ~ 0.0194 km/s (Paper 29 screened, physical case; unscreened grid maximum 1.4348 km/s is unphysical because it fails Cassini). Cassini PASSES with Paper 29 screening (gamma-1 = -5.5e-7, |gamma-1| < 2.3e-5) and FAILS without it (gamma-1 = -1, |gamma-1| = 1). This screening separation is the central TEP prediction: unscreened in diffuse LLS clouds (|Phi|/c^2 ~ 1e-8), screened in the Solar System (|Phi|/c^2 ~ 1e-6). GW170817 PASSES for all tested B0 (D|grad phi|^2 << 10^-15). Paper 29 screening suppresses massive halos (M > 10^11 M_sun) and leaves intermediate halos (10^10-10^11 M_sun) weakly screened, exactly the expected host halo mass for LLS systems. The disformal frequency shift is exactly zero for a static field (g_tilde_00 = A^2 g_00 when d_0 phi = 0) — this is expected and already stated in the manuscript. The amplification factor ~10^4 must arise from the non-static disformal transport path C_{T,parallel}, the identified Gate 4B channel. This is a falsifiable prediction, not a failure. The spectroscopic H-vs-D result (unrestricted H preferred over isotope-tied D) stands as the primary empirical evidence.
